label: Individuated veracity existential abstraction to legacy attitudes
term: existential extensional erasure of individuated attitudes
definition: erase σ S w C defines legacy Asserts(g,p) and Believes(g,p) by existence of an asserted/assented content c whose truth at w is equivalent to p. Knows is everywhere false.
